item.title: Trump reportedly told US could hit Iran as soon as Saturday, as he mulls potential strikes
item.description: US official confirms to ToI that Rubio will visit Israel on Feb. 28 to meet Netanyahu * IDF carries out overnight strikes on Hezbollah targets in southern Lebanon The post Trump reportedly told US could hit Iran as soon as Saturday, as he mulls potential strikes appeared first on The Times of Israel.

item.title: Israeli troops raid Hebron, nab suspects for questioning after reports of gunfire

item.title: Trump’s Board of Peace to convene for 1st time, as US bullish on disarmament prospects

item.title: Four killed in separate shootings, one by cops, as deadly crime surges in Arab society

item.title: Israel, US envoy reject Tucker Carlson’s claim he was detained and interrogated at airport
item.description: Popular anti-Israel conservative commentator briefly visits country to interview Huckabee; friend of the two who was present for interview says Carlson told her that Trump wants GOP infighting over Israel reined in The post Israel, US envoy reject Tucker Carlson’s claim he was detained and interrogated at airport appeared first on The Times of Israel.

item.title: Expansion of West Bank rule appears to shift ‘creeping annexation’ into higher gear

item.title: Vegetarian and vegan babies develop at same rate as meat-eating peers – Israeli study

item.title: US said planning to withdraw all American troops from Syria over next two months
